target: 除了永恒精灵用魔法保持永生，其他精灵通常能活一千年。

source: If you've the means to eliminate the little venom problem, these make miraculous instant drink-chilling straws.
target: 如果你有方法消除小小的毒液问题，这些螫针可以成为不可思议的冷冻吸管。

Alter the flow of energies through a staff.

target: 改变法杖中流动的能量性质。

deep_observation: 误译：源串为 npcs.lua 天赋名 Dismay（t-engine4 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/misc/npcs.lua:3654-3665，psionic/other 被动，info 为 "...have an %0.1f%% chance of becoming dismayed... the first melee attack against the foe will result in a critical hit"，并由 Combat.lua:1105/1946 的 EFF_DISMAYED 实现），语义为「惊惶/沮丧」（同版本 locales/ja_JP.lua:27032 译「失意のどん底」、ko_KR.lua:26674 译「경악」）。译文「黑暗痛苦」既非 dismay 的语义，也与该天赋施加的 Dismayed 状态（保证下一次近战暴击）无任何名义关联，割断天赋名与状态名的对应关系。
surface_observation: “Dismay”与“黑暗痛苦”含义明显不符，译文还无依据地增加了“黑暗”

source: - requires a target, your last hostile one will be automatically used
target: - 需要目标，会自动以最后一个敌对目标为对象

source: Causes the player's brain to jettison all recently-acquired knowledge.
target: 可以净化玩家的大脑，使玩家遗忘所有最近所学的技能。

source:
Slip into a lucid dream.  While in this state, you are considered sleeping, but can still act, are immune to insomnia, inflict %d%% more damage to targets under the effects of Insomnia, and your Physical, Mental, and Spell saves are increased by %d.
		Note that being asleep may make you more vulnerable to certain effects (such as Inner Demons, Night Terror, and Waking Nightmare).
		The saving throw bonuses scale with your Mindpower.
target:
你进入清晰梦境。在此状态下，你虽然处于睡眠状态但仍可以行动，并且对失眠免疫，对失眠状态下的目标附加 %d%% 伤害，同时，你的物理、法术和精神豁免增加 %d 点。
		注意在睡眠状态下会使你降低对特定负面状态的抵抗（例如心魔，梦魇复苏和梦魇降临）。
		受精神强度影响，豁免增益效果按比例加成。

source: Call upon the force of gravity to crush, push, and pull your foes.
target: 召唤重力粉碎、推动并拉扯敌人。

source: @Source@ shows @Target@ the madness of the void.
and corrupted into a pile of writhing worms
target: 并被腐化成了一堆蠕动的虫子

surface_observation: Unique 被错译为“史诗级物品”

source:
#GOLD#Damage penetration: all#LAST#
Reduces the amount of effective resistance of your foes to any damage you deal by this percent.
If you have 50% penetration against a creature with 50% resistance it will have an effective resistance of 25%.
This stacks with individual damage type penetrations.
You can never have more than 70% penetration.
surface_observation: 译文遗漏“by this percent”，未说明抗性是按该百分比降低
target:
#GOLD#伤害穿透：全体#LAST#
减少你造成伤害时目标的所有有效伤害抗性。
如果你对某种生物有50%全体伤害穿透，而那个生物有50%抗性，则最终这个生物的抗性为25%。
可以与独立类型的伤害穿透效果叠加。
抗性穿透最高不超过70%。

deep_observation: 漏译：源串（同 commit，game/modules/tome/data/timed_effects/magical.lua:2059，位于 EFF IMPENDING_DOOM 的 on_timeout，每 3 回合为施法者 incSoul(1) 时 logSeen 输出）明确把灵魂被撕裂归因于 Impending Doom（同文件 2040 行 desc="Impending Doom"，2046/2047 行状态标记 +Doomed/-Doomed）。译文「%s的灵魂被撕裂了一片！」删去 "by Impending Doom"，丢失了事件与该持续效果的归因关系，玩家无法从日志判断是哪个效果在生效并为施法者产出灵魂。
source: #CRIMSON#A piece of the soul of %s is torn apart by Impending Doom!
surface_observation: 译文遗漏造成灵魂撕裂的“Impending Doom”

Please spare me! I am pitiful. I will not stop you. Let me leave!
target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他跪了下来*#WHITE#

surface_observation: 原文“Blood Red Moon”没有“唤醒”含义，译文无据增译

source: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.

Water circles slowly on the ground around this naga's tail, some droplets leaping up now and then as if they are impatient to do their mistress' bidding. Her dark tail is coiled tight, making her look short, but her calm and confident stare assure you that she will not be easily overcome. As the water begins to rise around her the air starts to shimmer, and you feel her dark eyes are penetrating into you deeper than is comfortable.
target: 水流缓慢地围绕着这位娜迦的尾巴旋转，有些水珠不时跃起，似乎迫不及待要执行主人的命令。她黑色的尾巴蜷缩起来，使她看起来较为矮小，但是她沉着而自信的眼神让你确信她不是轻易就能被击败的。当周围的水位开始上涨，空气开始闪烁微光，你感到她漆黑的目光洞穿了你，让你很不自在。
受到治疗时，生命值维持在 %d 点以下。

source: If the sun doesn't set, dawn's power lasts forever.
target: 如果太阳永不落山，黎明的光辉将永恒。

target: 在战斗结束后，维网试图强迫你用你的身躯作为通道将维网传输到所有知觉生物的身体中。

source:
Crush together two alchemist gems, making them extremely unstable.
		You then throw them to a target area, where they explode on impact, dealing %0.2f physical damage and knocking back any creatures in the blast radius.
		Each kind of gem will also provide a specific effect.
		The damage will improve with better gems and with your Spellpower.
surface_observation: “使它们变的极度不稳定”中的“的”为明显用字错误，应为“得”
target:
将 2 颗炼金宝石压缩在一起，使它们变的极度不稳定。
		然后，你将它们扔到指定地点，爆炸会产生 %0.2f 物理伤害并击退爆炸范围内的任何怪物。
		每个种类的宝石都会提供一个特殊的效果。
		伤害受宝石品质和法术强度加成。

source: Your studies have uncovered much surrounding this subject, but now you must prepare for your glorious rebirth.
target: 你关于这个主题的研究已经令你发现了很多东西，现在，你必须准备你辉煌的重生仪式。

target: 将目标传送走。能有人成功走近并解除这个陷阱吗…？

target: 一位精通闪电法术的大法师。
